_published_faq.name: How do I add GameAnalytics Documentation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GameAnalytics Documentation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.docs.gameanalytics.com/.

_published_faq.name: Is GameAnalytics Documentation MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, GameAnalytics Documentation scores 82/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GameAnalytics Documentation MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GameAnalytics Documentation provides these MCP tools: docs_search and docs_fetch.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GameAnalytics Documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GameAnalytics Documentation in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does GameAnalytics Documentation MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: GameAnalytics Documentation does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
GameAnalytics Documentation is developed by GameAnalytics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
